news.h: Bucs down Falcons without pass completion; Bucky Irving, Kenny Gainwell run wild
news.d: Baker Mayfield didn't complete a pass, but the Buccaneers beat the Falcons 16-0 behind Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell's rushing on a wet, sloppy field.

news.h: Bucky Irving runs for 2 TDs and Bucs force 4 turnovers in 43-13 rout of Panthers
news.d: — The Tampa Bay Buccaneers wanted to make sure not to put too much on Baker Mayfield's plate with their quarterback still healing from a dislocated thumb and wearing a protective glove on his throwing hand.
